text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Trade regulatory body Office des Changes issues circular hailing decision to allow banks currency cross and exchanges of hard currencies with foreign banks, saying this openness will help develop and consolidate the market. Central Bank to issue guidelines on ways this will work.
- Interior ministry commission in parliament examines draft law for regionalisation.
- Interior ministry examines bids for purchase of 60,000 transparent ballot boxes to be used in next elections -- might be sign that old habits that tarnished Morocco's image will be broken.

- Council in charge of follow-up of accord signed between unions and government in August 1996 over minimum wage increase and other benefits has met several times but no decision to implement accord has emerged yet.

- Tourism receipts last year increased by 16 percent compared with the year before. But this rise should be considered cautiously because the figure represents a drop of 20 percent in comparison with 1994.
